title: You Don't Have to Switch Before January 1
script:
The third myth is, you have to switch before January 1st. That deadline is too strict. Here are the real dates.

Open Enrollment for 2027 coverage runs from October 15 to December 7, 2026. That's the window most people should use.

But if your plan isn't being renewed, you also get a Special Enrollment Period that can run through the last day of February.

And if you're using your federal right to buy a Medigap policy because your Medicare Advantage plan is leaving, that window is longer still.

It runs 60 days before your coverage ends through 63 days after. That's 123 days total, often stretching into early March.

During that window, insurers cannot reject you or charge you more for a pre-existing condition. Watch the full video, link in the description.
